daily.today_energy: Your inner fire is hitting different today, Leo. There's this magnetic pull around you—people are drawn to your vibe. Channel that confidence into something that actually matters to you right now.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your person needs to hear what's been on your mind. If you're solo, don't force anything—just show up as yourself and watch what naturally gravitates toward you.
daily.career: Your ideas have weight today. This is the energy to speak up in that meeting or share that project you've been sitting on. Trust your instincts; they're sharper than usual.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and sunlight. Even a short walk outside can reset your whole energy. Listen to what feels good rather than what you think you *should* do.

weekly.overview: Your energy is magnetic this week, Leo. The cosmos is rewarding your authenticity, so lean into what makes you feel alive. Trust the process, even when things feel uncertain. This is your moment to shine without apology.
weekly.love: Vulnerability is your superpower right now. Whether you're coupled or single, honest conversations flow easier than usual. Someone's paying attention to the real you—the messy, beautiful version. Let them in a little.
weekly.career: Your ideas are landing differently this week. Channel that creative fire into projects that actually excite you. Small wins are building momentum. Don't wait for permission to lead—your vision is needed right now.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not forced routines. Dance, walk, stretch—whatever makes you feel present. Rest isn't laziness; it's your superpower recharging. Listen to what your gut's telling you.
